reason: PLAN_TASK_CONTRACT_DEFECT: T012 cannot safely implement Party creation and detail updates within its adapter-only scope. `PartyMutationIntent` carries `CreatePartyCommand` or `PartyDetailsView`, but no Domain/Application-derived canonical `display_name`. The DBML explicitly requires Domain/Application to derive this value and persist source-name mutations with the resulting display-name update atomically; deriving it in the PostgreSQL adapter would place business policy in an outbound adapter.
